stories.title: Will Hong Kong see fewer creditor-led commercial property sales as assets stabilise?
stories.summary: Financial distress in Hong Kong’s commercial property market has moderated but not been completely eliminated, analysts say, with highly leveraged asset owners still expected to find refinancing their loans a challenge. stories.title: Could joint oil and gas projects help ease Beijing and Manila’s South China Sea tensions?
stories.summary: China and the Philippines have been urged to resume joint South China Sea energy exploration as a way of easing tensions in the disputed waters. A joint report by Chinese and Philippine analysts also said the two countries should work together in other “low-sensitivity” areas such as marine environmental protection and combating crime at sea.
